summary: Iron Man entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Iron Man
entries.definitive_edition: Owned PS3 or Xbox 360 HD console copy

emulation.notes: Use original HD console hardware/capture when possible; PC/handheld emulation only for branch comparison.

primary.why: The 2008 Iron Man game is a licensed movie tie-in with no sourced current storefront route. The PS3/Xbox 360 branch is the HD route for capture, while PC/PS2/Wii/PSP/DS releases should be labeled as separate lower-spec or handheld branches.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned PS3 or Xbox 360 copy, or compatible capture/emulation where legally available. Record platform, region, patch, difficulty, armor unlocks/upgrades, mission progress, controller/capture setup, and whether PC/PS2/Wii/handheld versions were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Alternate lower-spec branch and control routes
secondary.why: The HD console branch is the preferred capture route, but platform branches differ enough to log separately.
It is not the same route as the HD console game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No current official remaster/storefront route is sourced; record platform branch and media provenance.
